title: Beat Purchase Receipt and License Summary
summary: A short signed receipt for a beat purchase that records what was bought, the license type and its main limits.
useWhen: A producer sells a beat online or in person and wants a signed record that points to the full license terms.
watchOuts: A receipt is not the license. Attach or link the full license (non-exclusive lease, exclusive license or work-for-hire agreement), because it controls.
Make sure the license type and caps on the receipt match the full license.
Keep transaction IDs. Distributors and platforms often ask for proof of license when a beat is disputed.

variables.label: Order or transaction ID
variables.help: From the store or payment processor.

variables.label: Main limits
variables.default: Streams: 500,000. Sales: 5,000. Music videos: 1. Term: 3 years. No sync. No Content ID.

variables.label: Full license agreement
variables.help: Title and date, or link, of the full agreement.

variables.label: Producer's composition share
variables.help: Writer share of the new song.

sections.title: 1. Receipt
sections.body: {{producer_name}} ("Producer") confirms receiving {{price}} from {{buyer_name}} ({{buyer_email}}) on {{purchase_date}} by {{payment_method}}, transaction {{transaction_id}}, for the beat "{{beat_title}}". Files delivered: {{files}}.

sections.title: 2. License
3. Confirmation
sections.body: Buyer confirms receiving the files and the full license terms. Buyer: [[initial:buyer]]

sections.title: Signatures
sections.body:
By signing below, each party agrees to this document.

**Producer** — {{producer_name}}

[[sig:producer]]

Printed name: [[name:producer]]
Date: [[date:producer]]

**Buyer** — {{buyer_name}}

[[sig:buyer]]

Printed name: [[name:buyer]]
Date: [[date:buyer]]

disclaimer: This is a starting template from the Chucksi open contract library. It is not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship. Laws vary by state and change over time. Have a licensed attorney in your state review it before you sign. Music rights are split between the composition (song) and the sound recording (master); royalties also depend on PRO, publisher, distributor and label agreements that this template does not change. An entertainment attorney should review deals involving advances, ownership transfers or long terms.
